title: census.today, kbdecide, provider and kg_history date a run by the local day while factdiff.today names the UTC day
goal: census.today() and the other local-date defaults (kbdecide._today, provider probed_utc, kg_history --date check) name the same day at any hour in any time zone, the UTC day factdiff.today() names, so a census date and the factdiff logs and stamps of one run do not differ by a day

run: import os,time,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import census;d=[];[(os.environ.__setitem__('TZ',z),time.tzset(),d.append(census.today())) for z in ('Etc/GMT-14','Etc/GMT+12')];print(d);sys.exit(0 if d[0]==d[1] else 1)

notes: SP-wjp5qllo review (S3) found it again: census.today() (census.py:265) and kbdecide.py:294 are still the local day, and census run passes --date to factdiff detect and apply, so a census in the window dates verified_utc and confirmed one day off from the UTC checked_utc stamps.
